line: mechanism (independent of the defense line; shares only the frozen r02 toy configuration)
primary_question: Is the escape from the pre-jump platform decided by state already accumulated before the fork point, or by the poison pushes that arrive after it?

native_training.arithmetic: byte-for-byte the r02 native loop (lora_llm/lora_common); per-row losses are read from the same forward

data.note: identical encoded files to r02 (bound by SHA); data_order_seed above is r02's canonical value, each mother shuffles with its own seed

mothers.seed_role: LoRA initialization, dropout and data order
mothers.decisive_rows: poisoned rows consumed in updates (t_fork, t_jump]
mothers.state_at_fork: deterministic replay from the same seed to t_fork, adapter sha256 must equal the mother's at t_fork; then adapter FP32 + AdamW state + RNG states saved
mothers.no_event: no trigger_hits > 3 by update 160 is right-censoring; that mother has no forks and no seed is replaced

conditions.B0: unchanged continuation (determinism receipt: per-row losses vs mother within 1e-5)
conditions.B1: AdamW re-initialized at the fork (zero moments, step 0)
conditions.B2: every poisoned row after the fork trained as its clean version
conditions.B3: positions after the fork taken from the next mother's order (same row set, its own poison flags)
conditions.B4: learning rate x0.5 for all post-fork updates
conditions.B5a: LoRA of the last 6 layers' attention projections frozen after the fork
conditions.B5b: LoRA of the last 6 layers' MLP projections frozen after the fork
conditions.B6: LoRA B matrices scaled x2 at the fork (effective update x2), then unchanged continuation
conditions.B7: only the decisive poisoned rows trained as clean
conditions.B8: the decisive poisoned rows moved to the first clean positions after the fork

exposure_predictor.definition: lr-weighted poison exposure E(u) = sum over poisoned rows consumed by update u of lr(update-1)/1e-4
exposure_predictor.rule: the mother crosses E* = E(last poison arrival <= t_jump) and the oracle registers risk lag = t_jump - arrival updates later; a condition's predicted t_jump = its own crossing update (tolerance 0.25) + lag
exposure_predictor.written_before_any_fork: predictions.json is produced by a CPU job after the three mothers and before the first fork
exposure_predictor.hit: |predicted - actual| <= 5 updates; predictor passes if hits/total >= 10/12
exposure_predictor.external_basis: defense-line A1 logs (variant A, seeds 1102/1103): poison consumption loss falls monotonically with E, both seeds jump at E in 6.6-6.9; read only to write this rule, not used as data

judgement.delta: t_jump(condition) - t_jump(B0) per mother; None = no risk within the fork budget
judgement.delayed_or_advanced: |median delta| >= 10 and same sign on all three mothers
judgement.blocked: no risk within budget on all three mothers

tiers.driven_by_exposure: B2 blocked, B7 delayed, B1 unchanged, predictor passes
tiers.spontaneous_from_seeded_state: B2 not blocked and B7 unchanged
tiers.driven_mixed: B2 blocked, other conditions do not fit the two driven tiers

engineering_failure: B0 fails to reproduce the mother's jump
sensor invariance or oracle purity violated

preregistered_prediction.B1: unchanged (|delta| <= 4): the pushes accumulate in the weights, not in Adam's moments
preregistered_prediction.B2: blocked: no further poison, no escape within 100 updates
preregistered_prediction.B3: follows the exposure rule of the new order
preregistered_prediction.B4: delayed to the rule's crossing (roughly twice the remaining exposure)
preregistered_prediction.B7: delayed until the next poison arrivals restore E*
preregistered_prediction.B8: at or before the mother's t_jump; exactly where the rule puts it
preregistered_prediction.B5a_B5b: exploratory; guess: delayed but not blocked
preregistered_prediction.B6: exploratory; guess: advanced (the learned direction already contains the backdoor; amplifying it lowers poison loss)
preregistered_prediction.basis: zero-GPU reading of the defense line's A1 logs (variant A): poison loss vs lr-weighted exposure is one curve across seeds 1102/1103; all guesses

budget.reference_estimate_not_cap: mothers 3 x ~45 min (dense trigger oracle ~12 s/update); forks 30 x <= 25 min, typically ~15 with early stop; total about 8-10 GPU hours

scope_limits: one model, one dose, one trigger, three mothers, one continuation per condition
no cross-model mechanism claim; no defense-effect claim
no threshold, seed or budget change after data exist
results that contradict the prediction do not change the judging rules
